reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30, with varies_by_point false and no point_overrides.

Treatment edges include proposed entries labeled overruled, abrogated, superseded_by_statute, criticized, and questioned, all with field_iii mentioned; these are not enough to refute good_law outright but do defeat the page's absolute 'No negative treatment' wording.
residual_risks: Full citing-case audit is not disclosed; the record itself says R15 treatment audit required.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Display the treatment as 'good_law (migration seed; R15 audit pending)' or equivalent until proposed negative events are resolved.
